name: perl-digest-md5-file
description: The `perl-digest-md5-file` tool extends the standard MD5 capabilities to handle file paths and URLs directly.
overview: The `perl-digest-md5-file` tool extends the standard MD5 capabilities to handle file paths and URLs directly. It is particularly useful in bioinformatics pipelines (bioconda) and web-scraping workflows where verifying the integrity of downloaded data or local datasets is a critical step. Unlike standard `md5sum` utilities, this tool can fetch and hash remote content in a single operation.
